A character in Catalan mythology relating to a Christmas tradition widespread in Catalonia, Majorca, Occitania and Andorra.
Beginning with the Feast of the Immaculate Conception (December 8), one gives the Tio some food every night and covers him with a blanket. On Christmas Day or on Christmas Eve, one puts the Tio partially into the fireplace, and makes it defecate by beating the Tio with sticks, while singing various songs of Tio de Nadal.

RMB – open camera UI
